reader.requirement: At --std 85 the page heading's first print line goes on (a) its absolute LINE integer; (b) for a relative first line, the report heading's final LINE-COUNTER plus the integer when a report heading was presented on that page, otherwise HEADING integer-2 minus 1 plus the integer; (c) a page heading with no LINE NUMBER clause is not presented; on every page the page heading is presented, including pages after a NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE report heading.

reader.notes: The report heading's presence on the page is _rhOnThisPage, set only when the report heading actually presented lines and cleared by PageFeed, so a suppressed or NEXT PAGE report heading correctly leaves the page heading at the HEADING-based position. The refusal diagnostics for NEXT GROUP and NEXT PAGE cite §2023 numbers though the 1985 rules (XIII.3.16.3 SR5, XIII.3.15.3 SR7) say the same. Classes a, d, e, f do not apply to first-line placement.
